Customer Success | South Carolina, United States

Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is a TLV-based startup that’s on a mission to change the work experience for 80% of the world’s global workforce - the deskless employees.

Our business management platform helps thousands of businesses thrive by taking away the daily hustle and complexities of managing teams, so they can have the peace of mind to grow and run their business.

About the role:

The Customer Success Manager is responsible for managing a high-volume portfolio of low-touch mid-market and SMB customers in the US. This role focuses on proactive engagement at scale, ensuring customers achieve their business goals while maximizing the value of their Connecteam investment.

The ideal candidate has experience in digital-first customer success, leveraging automation, data analytics, and tech-touch strategies to drive adoption, retention, and expansion at scale. They should be comfortable handling a large portfolio, and balancing one-to-many outreach with personalized engagement where needed.

This is a fully remote position.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Scalable Customer Engagement: Manage a large portfolio of mid-market and SMB customers, using automation, webinars, in-app messaging, and other digital strategies to drive adoption and retention.
  • Proactive Lifecycle Management: Guide customers through adoption, and renewal phases using data-driven insights and segmentation-based engagement.
  • Customer Health Monitoring: Analyze customer health scores, usage data, and churn risk indicators to proactively intervene when needed.
  • Expansion & Growth: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by leveraging customer data and strategic outreach in collaboration with the sales team.
  • Escalation Management: Support customers who require higher-touch interventions, escalating to the appropriate teams when necessary.
  • Work with customers to create new use cases/success stories.

Which qualifications you’ll need:

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Scale CS, and Account Management – MUST
  • Experience managing a high-volume portfolio (100+ accounts) using tech-touch & automation – MUST
  • Proven ability to drive engagement and retention through digital programs, webinars, and self-service content.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to segment customers and trigger proactive outreach.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including experience with one-to-many communication strategies.
  • A team player who enjoys getting and providing feedback, sharing ideas, and constantly improving together.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, balancing multiple initiatives at once.
  • Experience collaborating with global teams across different time zones.
  • A growth mindset with a passion for continuously improving customer experience at scale.
  • Background in HR Tech, Workforce Management, or related industries - An Advantage.

Benefits:

  • Medical coverage.
  • Insurance plan.
  • Paid time off for vacation, sick days.

Salary range: 90K-100K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.

Joining Connecteam Is The Smart Move:

  • We build our people up. Every team member is treated as a long-term investment and we recognize the value in always nurturing and training them so they can go above and beyond in their skills and job duties.
  • We make an impact on our customer’s business. We are on a mission to provide managers of all business types and sizes with the tools they need to communicate, operate, engage, and run their deskless workforce. Our product offers them an effective and affordable solution to run their business.
  • We get the job done. Connecteam employees are passionate in executing their job duties so they can drive the company forward and provide real value to our customers.
  • We have fun! From weekly happy hours to holiday parties, we always enjoy each other’s company (and good food, of course). Connecteam is like one big, happy family!
  • Everyone is welcome. Connecteam is committed to building an encouraging, caring, and supportive environment. We share a responsibility to support our team and enrich their lives.

Together we will shape the future of work!

Job description

Atualmente, as Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce, entidade filantrópica, com aproximadamente 9 mil colaboradores, um dos maiores complexos de saúde 100% gratuito do país, com cerca de 5,6milhões de procedimentosambulatoriais por ano. Atendemos usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS),idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais,pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social. A organização conta com um perfil de serviços único no país, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora.


Main responsibilities

  • Conferir no mapa cirúrgico os materiais, equipamentos e instrumentais cirúrgicos necessários, conforme programação cirúrgica que envolvem OPME e equipamentos específicos para estes procedimentos;
  • Orientar a equipe médica quanto ao pedido de OPME;
  • Auxiliar no recebimento e conferência do material, junto a enfermeira do CME;
  • Instrumentar em cirurgias, na qual as empresas não disponibilizarem o instrumentador;
  • Treinamento da equipe do CME quanto ao manuseio, preparo e lavagem do OPME;
  • Realizar treinamento de preenchimento de nota de sala no CC;
  • Lavagem e preparo do material consignado restrito que permanece na instituição;
  • Disponibilizar o material para equipe da ortopedia no CC;
  • Realizar check list do material no arsenal, conhecer e identificar para reposição;
  • Quando necessário ser responsável pela assepsia, limpeza e acomodação do instrumental cirúrgico, durante o procedimento;
  • Conferir o material e funcionamento do instrumental cirúrgico antes e após o uso do mesmo;
  • Treinamento e manuseio do artroscópio;
  • Quando necessário realizar a contagem dos instrumentais em sala;
  • Desempenhar tarefas relacionadas a intervenções cirúrgicas médico-odontológicas, posicionando de forma adequada o instrumental, passando-o ao cirurgião e realizando outros trabalhos de apoio;
  • Conferir qualitativa e quantitativamente os instrumentos cirúrgicos, após o término das cirurgias;
  • Realizar a esterilização do material cirúrgico quando necessário;
  • Propor a aquisição de novos instrumentos para reposição daqueles que estão avariados ou desgastados;
  • Zelar, permanentemente, pelo estado funcional dos aparelhos que compõe as salas de cirurgia;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática.

title: Consultor de Produtos
description:
Job description

Na V.tal, acreditamos que a tecnologia conecta pessoas e transforma o futuro. Somos uma empresa inovadora e focada em excelência, operando com uma cultura dinâmica e colaborativa. Nosso time trabalha com autonomia, paixão e compromisso, sempre em busca dos melhores resultados.

Estamos em busca de um Consultor de Produtos - Pleno apaixonado por IA e com expertise em análise de performance para se juntar à nossa equipe. Você atuará em um ambiente desafiador e dinâmico, utilizando suas habilidades para analisar dados complexos, identificar tendências e gerar insights estratégicos que impulsionarão o crescimento da V.tal. Sua expertise será crucial para otimizar nossos processos, tomar decisões mais assertivas e garantir a excelência em nossos serviços.

Main responsibilities

  • Analisar o desempenho dos produtos de IA da V.tal, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de ação para otimizar a performance dos produtos, com base em dados e análises aprofundadas.
  • Construir e acompanhar os business plans dos produtos de IA, desde a defesa e aprovação orçamentária até a execução e apuração de ganhos efetivamente.
  • Monitorar indicadores chave de performance (KPIs) dos produtos de IA, realizando análises e relatórios periódicos para a equipe de liderança.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análises da concorrência para identificar tendências e oportunidades de inovação em IA.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de desenvolvimento de produto, marketing e vendas para garantir o sucesso dos produtos de IA.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência em análise de performance de produtos, com foco em IA.
  • Conhecimento profundo de metodologias de análise de dados e indicadores chave de performance (KPIs).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados, como SQL, Python, Power BI e outras ferramentas de BI.
  • Experiência em construção e acompanhamento de business plans.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar dados e insights de forma clara e concisa.
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Graduação em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Certificações em análise de dados, IA ou gestão de produtos (desejável).

Additional information

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • Programa de participação nos resultados (PPR)
  • Auxílio Farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Flexibilidade de horário
  • Clube de Vantagens V.tal
  • Licença maternidade estendida (6 meses)
  • Licença paternidade estendida (20 dias)

O FUTURO PASSA POR AQUI E É COM VOCÊ QUE IREMOS CONSTRUÍ-LO

Nós somos a V.tal, uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de viabilizar a conexão com o mundo digital, transformando a vida das pessoas. Trabalhamos para ajudar a incluir o Brasil no topo da lista dos países mais digitalizados do mundo, promovendo a inclusão digital, impulsionando novos negócios e estimulando o desenvolvimento regional.

E isso é possível porque já nascemos com a maior rede de fibra ótica do Brasil e com um time que faz acontecer. Somos uma rede neutra, compartilhada com operadoras, provedores e parceiros de todos os tamanhos e regiões. Isso nos enche de orgulho. Toda essa robustez nos permite oferecer abrangência e capilaridade para os nossos clientes irem mais longe, otimizando seus investimentos.

NOSSO TIME

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team:

The FIC team is responsible for creating and developing integrations between Trustly's product and financial institutions around the world. These connectors can be direct integrations, like a REST API, or other technologies that enable us to obtain the necessary information to authorize banking/financial transactions. The team also monitors the success rate of each connector and transactions, taking actions to maintain high product quality.


What you will do:

  3. Develop APIs.
  4. Address issues such as missing data or information in HTTP transactions.

title: Lab Technician
description:
iMM is recruiting a Lab Technician under an Employment Contract – Reference IMM/CT/50-2024

The iMM – Instituto de Medicina Molecular João Lobo Antunes is a leading Portuguese private non-profit research institute that offers a vibrant scientific environment, aiming to nurture innovative ideas in basic, clinical and translational Biomedical Research. Created in 2002, iMM Lisboa has established itself as a leading national and internationally competitive biomedical institute.

What iMM seeks : At this moment, iMM is looking for a Lab Technician to join the Organismal Metabolic Physiology Laboratory coordinated by Zita Carvalho-Santos, under the research project PTDC/BIA-CEL/3594/2020 – “The role of healthy cells on the elimination of premalignant cells” funded by Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT, I.P.) to execute the following activities under the supervision of Dr. Catarina Brás Pereira:

  • Maintenance and generation of Drosophila stocks;
  • Genotyping;
  • Dissection of Drosophila tissues;
  • Immunostaining and confocal microscopy;
  • Image analysis and data quantification.

Profile of Candidate

  • MSc in Biological Sciences;
  • Experience with image analysis (e.g. ImageJ, Imaris);
  • Focused, well-organized and very reliable working style;
  • Motivation and interest for science;
  • Good capacity and value for teamwork, and communication skills;
  • Ability to work and learn independently, critical thinking capacity to independently develop research project;
  • Fluency in English.

Preferential Factors

  • Research experience with hands-on technical experience in Drosophila husbandry and genetics, cell biology and molecular techniques and data analysis;
  • Knowledge in cancer cell biology and cell competition.

What iMM offers: iMM will offer outstanding working conditions in this area in Portugal, including a full-time and unfixed-term contract, starting predictably on the 1st of October 2024 for an estimated period of 5 (five) months. The selected candidate will be paid a gross monthly salary of 1.500€, in accordance with the funding budget and iMM Career By-Law, as well as Holidays and Christmas allowances subject to the current mandatory taxes according to Portuguese Labor Law. A meal allowance will also be paid in the amount of 6€ per each working day.

Please note that the job opportunity announced here is under the entity of the Instituto de Medicina Molecular João Lobo Antunes (iMM) and will result in a contractual relationship with the new entity, GIMM – Gulbenkian Institute for Molecular Medicine.

For more information about GIMM and the merger between IGC and iMM, please visit: . If you have any questions, please contact us at

How to apply: Please submit your Motivation Letter in English, Detailed CV and MSc degree certificate in PDF format to Human Resources through the email , from the 9th of August until the 6th of September 2024.

Note: Candidates who incorrectly formalize their application or do not submit the documents proving the compliance with the requirements indicated in the call will be excluded. The jury has the right to require any candidate, in case of doubt, to present documents proving their statements.

Non-discrimination and equal access policy : iMM promotes a non-discrimination and equal access policy, where no candidate can be privileged, benefited, impaired or deprived of any rights whatsoever based on their ancestry, age, sex, sexual preference, marital status, family and economic conditions, instruction, origin or social conditions, genetic heritage, reduced work capacity, disability, chronic illness, nationality, ethnic origin or race, origin territory, language, religion, political or ideological convictions and union membership.

International environment and experience: Diversity is a fundamental aspect of the essence of iMM, where researchers and non-researchers of different nationalities, backgrounds and areas of study work together, promoting the exchange of experiences and interactions, contributing to the personal and professional development of each person and to the existence of an international, inclusive and stimulating environment.

Pursuant to Decree-Law nr 29/2001 of 3rd February, disabled candidates shall be preferred in a situation of equal classification, and said preference supersedes any legal preferences. Candidates must declare, on their honour, their respective disability degree, type of disability and communication / expression means to be used during the selection period on their application form, under the regulations above.

Evaluation Criteria : Applications will be evaluated by Catarina Brás Pereira, Zita Carvalho Santos and Patrícia Francisco, in accordance with the following method:

  • 1st Phase: Curricular evaluation (50%) and Motivation Letter (25%);
  • 2nd Phase: Interview (25%). Only the 3 candidates with the highest score in the 1st Phase with a minimum of 65% will be selected for Interview.

Neo4j is the leader in Graph Database & Analytics, helping organizations uncover hidden patterns and relationships across billions of data connections deeply, easily, and quickly. Over 84% of Fortune 100 companies use Neo4j, along with a vibrant community of 250,000+ developers, data scientists, and architects across the globe.

At Neo4j, we’re proud to build the technology that powers breakthrough solutions for our customers. These solutions have helped NASA get to Mars two years earlier, broke the Panama Papers for the ICIJ, and are helping Transport for London to cut congestion by 10% and save $750M a year. Some of our other notable customers include Intuit, Lockheed Martin, Novartis, UBS, and Walmart.

Growth was further fueled by enterprise demand for Neo4j’s cloud offering and partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and ecosystem leaders. Learn more at neo4j.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

JOB TITLE: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)

Location : Ideally based in or near São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil OR Miami, FL,. Travel will be required especially if based outside of São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview As a key driver of revenue growth in our LATAM region, particularly in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our ambitious revenue targets. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) who can craft and execute high-impact marketing strategies and demand generation programs that align with regional pipeline and revenue objectives.

Reporting Structure The Senior RMM will be an integral member of our Americas Marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Americas Marketing. This role requires building robust partnerships with the Neo4j LATAM sales team and collaborating effectively with various departments, including corporate marketing, digital, developer relations, communications (PR), and product marketing, to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Development : Formulate and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for the LATAM region, incorporating digital marketing, partnerships, public relations (in collaboration with an agency and the communications team), account-based marketing (ABM), and event initiatives aimed at generating leads, opportunities, and deals.
  • Performance Accountability : Lead the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to meet key performance indicators, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Continuously evaluate and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs to enhance execution, efficiency, and overall results.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work collaboratively across all marketing functions to design and implement effective lead generation programs, encompassing digital initiatives, corporate events, and webinars.
  • Event Coordination : Define and implement LATAM-specific events and demand generation programs, including owned events, roadshows, workshops, and participation in third-party conferences. This includes audience segmentation, registration management, promotion, lead handling, and outcome tracking.
  • Channel Partnership : Cultivate and expand engagement with regional channel partners (GCP and AWS) through joint marketing initiatives.
  • Sales Development Partnership : Work closely with Sales Development teams to gather feedback, ensuring timely and effective follow-up on leads.
  • Strategic Communication : Effectively communicate marketing strategies, value propositions, positioning, and messaging to the LATAM sales team, ensuring they are equipped with the latest, most compelling content for effective sales cycles.
  • PR : Assist in facilitating customer and press participation in local activities, including press releases, case studies, event presentations, and industry awards.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be a key member of the Americas Regional Marketing team. The team is responsible for driving the highest quality lead generation programs that take customers and prospects through their buyers’ journey using all activities in the marketing mix including digital, partner and event programs.

As a Senior Regional Marketer, you will drive opportunities and pipeline growth by developing and executing on a quarterly marketing plan based on approved budgets. You’ll recommend digital programs, specific regional activities and local events, and determine what demand generation content needs will drive business results for the region. This position requires significant cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

  • Languages : Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is required for this role. While not required, proficiency in Spanish is considered a strong plus.
  • 7+ years in Regional Marketing, with a proven track record in developing and executing pipeline-generation programs, digital initiatives, and events. Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) is a plus.
  • 5+ years collaborating on PR and thought leadership strategies for regional growth.
  • Strong demand generation expertise, analytical abilities, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience in event planning, execution, and post-event analysis.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to meet goals.
  • Goal-oriented self-starter with a proactive, independent work style who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead projects from concept to completion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to work at both the tactical and strategic levels, including effective budget management and ROI optimization.
  • Technical Proficiency : Advanced knowledge of Marketo, Tableau and Salesforce is essential.
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph database in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.
  • Neo4j was named as a Visionary in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Database Management Systems among 19 other recognized global DBMS vendors. Neo4j was also ranked as a Strong Performer among 14 top vendors in The Forrester Wave: Vector Databases, Q3 2024.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Gameplay Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other Epic projects. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact Gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent gameplay teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team
  • Working closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets. This will also include mentorship of rigging-focused technical animators
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles. Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver
  • Control Rig experience a plus
  • Python programming is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Main responsibilities

O Arquiteto de Software exerce o papel de líder tecnológico dos times de desenvolvimento, atuando proativamente na proposição de soluções técnicas, no diagnóstico de problemas e na superação de obstáculos relacionados a codificação e implementação dos frameworks e componentes da arquitetura de referência. Ele deve garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam aos requisitos de negócios, técnicos e operacionais, além de buscar o máximo retorno da arquitetura de software em termos de desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, confiabilidade e relação custo/benefício.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e criar configuração de software, apoiar o empacotamento e revisar versões de pacotes de software.

  • Atuar em conjunto com as equipes ágeis e com o dono do produto para definir, dimensionar e priorizar histórias e planejar sprints e releases.

  • Analisar e diagnosticar incidentes de software e falhas de integração de sistemas novos e legados.
  • Registrar e solucionar débitos técnicos identificados após as entregas.
  • Orientar e atuar na modernização de soluções legadas e refatoração de código.
  • Orientar e prestar mentoria técnica aos perfis com menor experiência.
  • Definir e implementar soluções especializadas com utilização de arquitetura blockchain, cloud, big data, inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina, entre outras.
  • Atuar junto ao time de arquitetura propondo e auxiliando no processo de definições da arquitetura de referência.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência mínima de 08 (oito) anos em atividades de engenharia de software com linguagens JAVA e JAVASCRIPT e pelo menos 03 (três) anos como Arquiteto/Projetista de Software.
  • Conhecimentos consolidados em arquiteturas On Premise e Cloud, modelos de desenvolvimento e bancos de dados Oracle e Postgres.
  • Conhecimentos em qualidade de softwares (Ex: BDD, TDD, testes unitários, testes integrados, etc).
  • Vivência na operação com esteiras de CI/CD, Design Patterns, Serverless, DevOps e DevSecOps.
  • Implantação e configuração de serviços em ambiente Openshift ou Kubernetes.
  • Implementação, suporte e proposição de soluções de autenticação e autenticação: OpenId Connect, One-way-ssl e Two-way-ssl.
  • Controle de versões com GIT.
  • Experiência mínima de 03 (três) anos nas seguintes tecnologias e processos:
  1. Angular e REST;
  2. HTML 5 e CSS;
  3. Hibernate;
  4. Arquitetura de microsserviços ou serviços SOA e desenvolvimento de web services;
  5. Servidor de aplicações JBoss;
  6. Maven/Jenkins (Geração/Automatização de builds);
  7. Sonar (Validação de builds);

Formação:

  • Graduação completa nas seguintes áreas: Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Processamento de Dados, Sistemas de Informação, Informática, Engenharia da Computação ou demais áreas de Tecnologia da Informação.

Certificação:

Possuir, no mínimo, duas certificações dos grupos abaixo , emitido(s) pela Sun Microsystems ou pela Oracle (upgrade de versão será considerado como uma única certificação):

  • Sun Certified Web Component Developer (SCWCD) EE5 ou OCE - Java EE Web Component Developer.
  • Sun Certified Business Component Developer (SCBCD) EE5 ou OCE – Business Component Developer.
  • Sun Certified Developer for Java Web Services 5 ou 6 (SCDJWS) ou OCE – Web Services Developer.
  • Sun Certified EJB Developer for the Java EE6 Platform ou OCE - Java Platform, Enterprise Edition 6 Enterprise JavaBeans Developer.

Especialista de Planejamento e Controle Pleno - Vaga afirmativa exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022, a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar rotinas de orçamentação, criando relatórios detalhados para análise crítica;
  • Avaliar a viabilidade dos projetos propostos pela empresa, considerando aspectos financeiros, operacionais e estratégicos;
  • Gerir os indicadores de performance, identificando áreas de melhoria e oportunidades de otimização;
  • Sugerir e implementar ferramentas de acompanhamento dos resultados, garantindo a precisão e atualização das informações;
  • Preparar material de apresentações com análise de resultados e projeções para reuniões executivas;
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões, apresentando os materiais elaborados e fornecendo análise crítica dos números apresentados;
  • Colaborar com outros departamentos para alinhar estratégias e garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos organizacionais;
  • Desenvolver planos de ação para corrigir desvios e garantir o alcance das metas estabelecidas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office avançado, com ênfase em Excel;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Fácil acesso ao Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em resultado, qualidade e no cliente.

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental;
  • AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
  • Gympass - Acesso a academias e demais atividades de bem-estar;
  • Auxílio creche para as mães;
  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Sobre a Aegea

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem-estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias têm de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficientes e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

description:
Você é aquela pessoa que gosta de interagir com clientes? Gosta de organizar e movimentar mercadorias? É fascinado (a) por organização? Então confere só a descrição de como será seu dia aqui conosco!

Descrição

  1. Preparação de Pedidos: Recebe e processa pedidos de produtos para garantir sua preparação e envio eficiente, organizando itens no estoque de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos para facilitar o acesso rápido durante a preparação de pedidos.
  2. Manuseio de Produtos: Manuseia produtos internamente na área de expedição, estoque e loja.
  3. Conferência de Inventário: Mantém registros precisos dos níveis de estoque, realizando verificações regulares para garantir a conciliação entre o sistema e o estoque físico, informando sobre discrepâncias ou itens em falta para evitar atrasos nas remessas.
  4. Embalagem e Rotulagem: Embala produtos de forma segura e adequada, seguindo padrões específicos da empresa, rotulando corretamente as embalagens, incluindo informações de remessa, códigos de barras e outros dados relevantes.
  5. Coordenação de Envios: Colabora com transportadoras para organizar a coleta e entrega de produtos, gerenciando documentações necessárias para envios e entregas a clientes.
  6. Manuseio de Equipamentos: Utiliza equipamentos de movimentação de materiais, como empilhadeiras ou carrinhos, de maneira segura e eficiente para movimentar produtos no estoque, área de vendas e expedição.
  7. Controle de Qualidade: Verifica a qualidade dos produtos antes da entrega e envio, identificando e separando itens danificados ou defeituosos, assegurando que os produtos enviados atendam aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
  8. Registro de Dados: Mantém registros precisos de todas as atividades de expedição, incluindo detalhes sobre pedidos, remessas, devoluções e inventário, utilizando sistemas de gerenciamento de inventário e software de expedição conforme necessário.
  9. Atendimento a Prazos: Cumpre prazos de envio estabelecidos para garantir a entrega pontual dos produtos aos clientes, comunicando-se proativamente com clientes e equipes internas sobre atrasos ou problemas potenciais.
  10. Resolução de Problemas: Identifica e resolve problemas relacionados à expedição, como atrasos na entrega, danos a produtos e questões de embalagem.
  11. Trabalho em Equipe: Colabora com outros membros da equipe de expedição, armazém e atendimento ao cliente para otimizar processos e melhorar a eficiência geral.
  12. Segurança: Segue procedimentos de segurança ao manusear produtos, operar equipamentos e realizar tarefas de expedição.

O Auxiliar de Manutenção Civil é responsável em auxiliar nas atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em estruturas e instalações civis. As responsabilidades incluem:

  11. Zelar pela manutenção, limpeza e conservação do local de trabalho;
  12. Executar outras tarefas compatíveis com as exigências para o exercício da função.

O Grupo Onet é uma referência global nas áreas de facilities, engenharia e segurança, com um compromisso sólido com a responsabilidade social e a capacitação profissional contínua. Nossa marca se destaca por aplicar tecnologia de ponta no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras, sustentáveis e de alta performance.

Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.

Enfermeiro(a) - Serviços Hospitalares

O que você irá realizar:

Cumprir os processos e atividades de assistência aos pacientes em programa de diálise domiciliar e/ou hospitalar com diagnóstico de injúria renal aguda em recuperação, crônica ou crônica-agudizada submetidos às modalidades de Terapia Renal Substitutiva (TRS), visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o uso adequado de equipamentos de proteção individual, o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, operacionais e administrativas estabelecidas pela Franqueadora e legislação vigente, bem como a garantia da sua segurança no ambiente de trabalho. Ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  1. Formação em Enfermagem e pós graduação em Nefrologia concluída.
  2. Registro no Órgão competente ativo (COREN);
  3. Experiência na área de Nefrologia e CTI;
  4. Disponibilidade de horário;
  5. Desejável conhecimento no pacote Office e em informática;
  6. Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;

Informações complementares:

  1. Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP
  2. Unidades em vários locais.
  3. Oferecemos salário e benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

A Fresenius Medical Care agradece o seu interesse e disponibilidade em participar de nosso processo seletivo!

ADP is hiring a Lead Developer Backend - Lyric Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?

In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved web applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients. You will work with clients, product managers, architects, software engineers, and more to plan, design, develop, test, and implement impactful solutions that support companies with one to millions of employees.

You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code. Every three weeks, you will be involved in the release activities.

As a Lead Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:

  • Strong Java developer with REST API, spring and Spring-boot development experience;
  • NodeJS, Kafka, MySQL,Kubernets, Splunk, GoldenGate;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in writing JUNITs for coverage;
  • Good understanding of Jenkins pipelines and CI/CD process;
  • Advanced English;

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

  • Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.
  • Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

description:
At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce barriers to building a family. We help our customers and their patients fulfill the dream of having a baby.

The Global Marketing team is seeking a skilled marketing professional responsible for shaping the global strategy of our genetic testing solutions, including launches, concepts, and campaigns. You will lead our consumer and patient initiatives, collaborating closely with Product Directors and Regional Marketing teams.

With excellent communication skills, digital savviness, and extensive marketing experience, you know how to translate strategy into targeted content delivered to the right audience at the right time. You excel in multicultural and cross-functional collaboration, preferably within a global context involving multiple stakeholders.

Managing diverse processes and projects requires a pragmatic, positive, and creative mindset, with both strategic and operational focus. A solid business acumen is essential to identify and capitalize on growth opportunities. You will be part of the broader Global Marketing & Academy team, reporting to the VP of Global Marketing, and will experience a collaborative environment.

Please note: Only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

Main Responsibilities

  1. Develop and communicate a clear, visionary marketing strategy aligned with Vitrolife Group’s long-term objectives for genetic testing solutions.
  2. Lead the development of value propositions, marketing plans, campaigns, and sales tools on a global scale.
  3. Plan and implement a marketing mix with a strong focus on digital strategies, including web, email campaigns, webinars, and social media content.
  4. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on service launches and campaigns, ensuring commercial impact through effective execution.
  5. Work closely with upstream product management to incorporate customer and market insights into product vision and roadmaps.
  6. Develop patient marketing concepts and campaigns to ensure effective communication and lead generation from this audience.
  7. Monitor campaign and launch effectiveness, continuously improving marketing activities.

Requirements

  • A master’s degree in marketing, communication, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in regional or global marketing roles.
  • At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, omnichannel strategies, and marketing automation related to customer journey digitalization.
  • Strong background in marketing and brand management, preferably within the medical device or fast-moving consumer industry.
  • Business and financial acumen, with experience managing marketing budgets and analyzing sales data to inform campaigns and launches.

The interview will be conducted in English. The employee will be based in Valencia (Parque tecnológico de Paterna).

We look forward to receiving your application!

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services, developing products for personalized genetic information and medical devices to improve fertility treatments. With approximately 1,100 colleagues worldwide, headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden, and products available in over 110 countries, we aim to be the market leader and partner of choice for IVF clinics, fulfilling the dream of having a baby. Our shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Component Leader(d/f/m)
description:
We are seeking an Elevator Architect to join our R&D team and assist us in creating a standard global elevator product architecture, which includes the functional definition of modules and module interfaces.

You will be a member of the Global Product Architecture Team, which comprises system architecture methodology experts who coordinate and drive the creation of deliverables for the Modular Product Architecture Project.

You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders from R&D, PLM, PSM, MFG, and Field/Sales, as well as experts in all product areas, to standardize key module interfaces to minimize rework when module implementation changes.

You will also participate in the Product Architecture Update Process, which establishes the methodology and standard work for updating the architecture and standard interfaces.

This activity is a high priority for our company, as it will enable R&D efficiency and cost reduction for all elevator products.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Platform Development: Lead the development and maintenance of core platform components, including kernel modules, device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware abstraction layers, ensuring seamless integration with hardware and higher-level software layers.
  2. System Image Customization: Lead the creation of Linux-based system images using the Yocto Project, tailoring configurations to meet specific hardware and project requirements.
  3. Platform Tooling and Abstraction Layers: Build and maintain tools, APIs, and abstraction layers that simplify application development. Provide a reliable and efficient platform that enables application teams to focus on delivering innovative solutions.
  4. Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of developers focused on platform development. Cultivate technical growth within the team by sharing expertise in embedded software development. Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability to achieve high-quality deliverables.
  5. Planning and Transparency: Track team progress and ensure alignment with project timelines and deliverables. Maintain clear visibility into development activities, identify risks early, and adjust plans as needed to meet committed deadlines. Report progress and challenges to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  6. Collaboration and Team Work: Work closely with the Technical Leader, Product Owner, other Component Leaders and stakeholders to align platform development with broader project goals. Collaborate with hardware engineers, platform, application and test automation teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across the solution.

Qualifications:

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  2. Experience: 7+ years of experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on low-level programming and Linux-based platforms.
  3. Skills:
    • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems, kernel programming, and hardware-software integration.
    • Experience with the Yocto Project for system image building and customization.
    • Proficiency in developing device drivers, BSPs, and hardware abstraction layers.
    • Familiarity with hardware and networking communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, GSM.
    • Strong experience with troubleshooting of complex problems in diverse environments.
    • Basic knowledge for reading electronic schematics and datasheets.
    • Familiarity with end-to-end testing approaches and test automation, preferably with hardware-in-the-loop testing, to ensure reliable integration and quality of embedded systems.
    • Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  4. Soft Skills:
    • Strong ability to interact and align with stakeholders and technical leaders across the company, ensuring effective communication and shared understanding of project goals.
    • Proven ability to contribute to a collaborative team environment, always working as a team player and actively supporting colleagues and driving collective success.
    • Highly collaborative with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
    • Clear and effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.
  5. Language: Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience with hardware development.
  2. Experience working in a global environment with cross-functional teams.
  3. Background in digital transformation, connectivity solutions, or IoT in the industrial or building automation sector.

Amazon is looking for a Senior Program Manager to drive carbon reduction in our Brazil transportation operations including through adoption of Low Carbon Fuels and Electrification, as part of our Rest of World (ex North America, Europe) Operations Sustainability team.   4. Engage in public-private partnerships and industry coalitions to unlock innovative solutions. Partner with Public Policy teams to identify key policy opportunities to accelerate zero/low-carbon fuels and transportation technology adoption.
  5. Drive broad engagement among leaders and Amazon colleagues at all levels to influence decision-making and daily behaviors toward sustainability goals.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Working experience of program or project management.

title: Articulador Social- São Paulo/SP
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto, a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando e realizando os eventos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

Job Title: Safety, Health, Environment, and Risk (SHER) Manager

About The Role

Stelo HRM is supporting one of its clients in the mining sector to recruit an experienced SHER Manager to oversee the Construction and Implementation Phase of a mining project in Angola. The SHER Manager will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive Safety, Health, Environment, and Risk systems, ensuring full compliance with both local legislation and international best practices.

This is a senior-level, site-based role requiring strong leadership, stakeholder management, and operational oversight in a high-risk environment.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead and manage the SHER team during the project's construction and implementation phases.
  2. Oversee the SHER component of the operational readiness workstream.
  3. Ensure alignment with the business's zero-harm health and safety strategy and environmental stewardship objectives.
  4. Develop and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  5. Approve and review SHER reports, data, and statistics as required by the organization.
  6. Develop and maintain SHER-related policies, processes, and procedures.
  7. Design and implement risk management systems in line with company and legislative requirements.
  8. Coordinate and ensure effective delivery of internal and external audits, certifications, and inspections.
  9. Lead SHER-related meetings, ensuring timely execution of action items.
  10. Liaise with relevant government institutions during site visits and inquiries.
  11. Provide regular business intelligence on SHER matters to relevant parties.
  12. Identify and implement appropriate SHER tools, systems, and technologies.
  13. Ensure compliance with group-level SHER policies and support SHER staff development.
  14. Oversee delivery of SHER training programmes.
  15. Uphold high standards of corporate governance and compliance.

Qualifications And Experience

  1. Degree or diploma in Safety Management, Occupational Hygiene, Environmental Management, or related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  2. Membership in a professional accreditation body is preferred.
  3. Demonstrated experience in leading SHER programmes in risk-based environments, ideally involving large-scale construction projects.
  4. Strong knowledge of Angolan SHE legislation and standards.

Ericsson is seeking a seasoned professional to lead the enhancement and management of our compensation design practices and digitalize our Short-Term Variable pay processes. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation, preferably with AWS
  • 5+ years experience related to machine learning, deep learning, NLP, CV, GNN, or distributed training.
  • Able to communicate effectively in English and Portuguese, within technical and business settings.
Preferred Qualifications
  • AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, EMR, S3 and EC2)
  • AWS Certification (Solution Architect Associate, Machine Learning Engineer Associate)
  • Working knowledge of generative AI and hands on experience in prompt engineering, deploying and hosting Large Foundational Models.

Técnico Segurança do Trabalho – RP 16158 Sistema Fiep (Fiep, Sesi, Senai e IEL)

Quais são os desafios e as principais responsabilidades?

  • Assegurar o atendimento à legislação de SST aplicável nas casas do Sistema FIEP mediante a responsabilidade técnica junto ao SESMT, com o objetivo de garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro e em conformidade com as normas de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho.

  • Avaliar, liberar e acompanhar atividades de risco (trabalho em altura, espaço confinado, eletricidade).

  • Análise documental e liberação de prestadores de serviços.
  • Acompanhamento e fiscalização do atendimento de requisitos de SST em obras.
  • Tratativa das inconsistências do eSocial.
  • Avaliação de mudança de risco para movimentações e novas ocupações.

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo;
  • Conhecimento técnico na área de Segurança no Trabalho e Aperfeiçoamento em NR's;

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Técnico em Meio Ambiente . O profissional será inserido em projeto de eficiência energética, cuja lógica é a de troca de resíduos recicláveis por bônus na fatura de energia elétrica. Tal iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O profissional terá como responsabilidade principal a elaboração de Estudos de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, emissão e controle de Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos - MTR, processamento de dados e emissão de relatórios. Além disso, fornecerá suporte abrangente às atividades do projeto, auxiliando o Supervisor de Operação nas rotinas de monitoramento dos pontos de coleta fixos e itinerantes, e deverá apoiar o Coordenador do projeto no acompanhamento das atividades e metas gerais.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica (EVT) relacionado ao gerenciamento de resíduos recicláveis;
  2. Identificar e contatar potenciais clientes, especialmente grandes geradores de resíduos, em busca de novas parcerias;
  3. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, para avaliação de novos parceiros e abertura de ecopontos, bem como emitir e controlar os MTR - Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos, produzidos pelos ecopontos;
  4. Manter contato e relacionamento proativo com os clientes do projeto;
  5. Aumentar o nível qualitativo das coletas dos grandes geradores por meio da execução de assistências técnicas, treinamentos e palestras sobre melhores práticas de gerenciamento de resíduos;
  6. Identificar e promover o tratamento de eventuais não conformidades;
  7. Alimentar os indicadores do projeto e emitir relatórios periódicos de desempenho;
  8. Auxiliar e prestar suporte operacional sempre que necessário ao Supervisor de Operações.

  • Apuração de Tributos:
    • Realizar a apuração de impostos diretos e indiretos, como ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, e CSLL.
    • Fazer a conferência dos documentos fiscais, como notas fiscais de entrada e saída, para garantir que os tributos estejam corretamente calculados.
  • Elaboração e Envio de Obrigações Acessórias:
    • Preparar e transmitir as obrigações acessórias, como a DCTF, SPED Fiscal, GIA (Guias de Informação e Apuração do ICMS), e outras declarações exigidas pelos órgãos fiscais.

    • Realizar análises tributárias para identificar oportunidades de redução de carga tributária de forma legal.
    • Fornecer consultoria aos clientes sobre as implicações fiscais de transações comerciais ou de novos projetos.
  • Revisão e Classificação Fiscal:
    • Realizar a revisão e a classificação correta das operações fiscais, atribuindo o código fiscal adequado a cada tipo de operação (como produtos ou serviços).
  • Planejamento Tributário:
    • Auxiliar na elaboração de planejamentos tributários para melhorar a eficiência fiscal e garantir a conformidade com as leis fiscais.
    • Analisar os impactos tributários de novas legislações ou mudanças no cenário fiscal.
  • Auditorias e Fiscalizações:
    • Preparar e organizar documentos e relatórios fiscais para auditorias internas ou externas.

As a Full Stack Developer, you must be able to adjust to constant business change and as needed to proactively plan for changes that are likely to occur. These solutions must be aligned with business and IT strategies and are in compliance with the organization’s architectural standards. Responsibilities beyond development of software may include participation in component and data architecture design, technology planning, product evaluation, advanced testing processes and buy vs. build recommendations. Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with a distributed team of 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries. Teams meet in person a few times a year in various locations worldwide.

Our regional Support Managers lead world-class support teams—solving complex technical problems for customers using Ubuntu Server, Desktop, and the public cloud. Key attributes include customer focus and technical excellence. We are hiring managers for both our Cloud Support Group and Devices Support Group.

The role involves:

  1. Managing a professional support team, including skills development and performance management.
  2. Operational control, shift scheduling, and KPI accountability.
  3. Ensuring customer cases are responded to within SLA and professionally.
  4. Acting as the escalation contact for customers.
  5. Maintaining customer satisfaction.
  6. Contributing to the knowledge base.
  7. Improving team processes and support delivery.
  8. Hiring, developing, and training support staff.
  9. Collaborating with leadership on growth and transformation initiatives.

Qualifications include:

  • Extensive CLI experience with Linux (Support, Development, Implementation).
  • Leadership and team management experience.
  • Ability to work under pressure with a strong customer focus.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in another language is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Knowledge of Linux Desktop, OpenStack, Public Cloud, or Virtualization.
  • Contributions to Open Source projects.
  • Software development experience.
  • Experience in support organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with Canonical's products.

We offer:

  • A distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • A USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation reviews and performance bonuses.
  • Additional benefits aligned with our values, including holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme, travel opportunities, and more.

About Canonical:

We are pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud computing. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a remote-friendly culture since 2004. Working here challenges you to think differently and grow your skills.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications fairly, regardless of background or identity.

Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.

Job Description
About Pyyne
 Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.
At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.
Job Summary
Pyyne is seeking a Microsoft Migration Specialist for a contractor position to lead a large-scale migration from Google Workspace (Gmail) to Microsoft 365 for one of our enterprise clients in the insurance sector.
This role is pivotal to ensuring a seamless and secure transition of email, calendars, contacts, and collaboration tools to the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Google-to-Microsoft migrations and be comfortable working in enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and complex dependencies.
Key Responsibilities
Migration Planning & Execution:

  • Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of the Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration.
  • Analyze existing Gmail and Google Drive environments to define migration scope, approach, and timeline.
  • Execute migrations of mail, calendars, contacts, and files using best-in-class tools and methodologies.
  • Utilize tools such as BitTitan MigrationWiz or Google Workspace Migration for Microsoft Exchange (GWMME).
Cloud Integration & Configuration:
  • Set up and configure Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Establish user accounts, mail flow rules, retention policies, and security configurations.
  • Manage identity synchronization with Azure Active Directory and configure appropriate access policies.
Troubleshooting & Support:
  • Identify and resolve data transfer issues, permission conflicts, and post-migration inconsistencies.
  • Serve as an escalation point during and after the migration to ensure minimal business disruption.
  • Document procedures and provide training or handoff support to internal IT teams.
Stakeholder Communication:
  • Work closely with client IT teams, project managers, and business stakeholders to ensure clarity and alignment throughout the project.
  • Provide regular updates, status reports, and risk assessments during the project lifecycle.
Qualifications
Experience & Skills:
  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise IT, including at least 2 successful migrations from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.
  • In-depth knowledge of:
    • Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 configuration.
    • Google Workspace admin console and architecture.
    • Identity and access management via Azure AD.
    • Migration tools like BitTitan, GWMME, or CloudMigrator.
  • Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, and email archiving best practices in Microsoft 365.
Soft Skills:
  • Ability to lead and manage large-scale projects independently.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a user-focused mindset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
Location:
  • Remote-first
The Ideal Candidate
 You are a technically strong, execution-oriented migration expert with specific experience moving enterprise clients from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365. You enjoy working in dynamic environments and understand the importance of a seamless user experience during complex transitions. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and confident in taking ownership of end-to-end delivery.
Benefits
  • Competitive hourly contractor rate based on experience.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a business-critical migration for a major insurance organization.
  • Potential for future engagements with Pyyne’s expanding enterprise client portfolio
